lines.1: Today is the day of my appointment with Ms. Inori.
lines.2: She told me to stay here and work late.
lines.3: My heart pounds harder as evening draws near.
lines.4: Not knowing what we will do leaves me caught between anticipation and anxiety.
lines.6: 「Yeah, I'm going to work a little longer. You can go on ahead.」
lines.7: 「Really? Then I'll leave the key. Return it to Ms. Inori for me.」
lines.11: But then I remember what the Princess said yesterday.
lines.12: There is no village on Mount Senjo in Oeyama.
lines.14: Is Ms. Inori hiding some kind of secret?
lines.17: Ms. Inori is standing in the doorway before I even notice her.
lines.18: 「Good. You stayed behind alone, just as I instructed.」
lines.20: 「Please relax. Mr. Tsuchinaga is not here now, either.」
lines.22: Apparently I had braced myself without realizing it.
lines.23: 「How have you found the student council, Tsushima?」
lines.24: 「It's noisy, sure, but I'm having fun.」
lines.25: 「Do you think you can win over the Princess you admire, or Kurogane?」
lines.26: 「W-win them over...? Why would you suddenly ask that?」
lines.27: 「Is there a problem with us living together after all?」
lines.28: 「Nothing of the sort. Kurogane is a model student, every bit as much as Yoppi.」
lines.29: 「I merely wondered whether you, as a man, had any interest in Kurogane or Kiriya.」
lines.32: 「I don't understand what you're getting at.」
